detailed_notes.testing_approach: Attempted comprehensive E-7 frontend testing via Playwright browser automation. Focused on 9 user stories covering internal requests, inventory board, PO creation, suppliers, interco transactions, loans, margin reports, asset transfers, and cash management.
detailed_notes.navigation_architecture: Application uses state-based navigation (activeView state) rather than URL routing. Sidebar menu items have data-testid='nav-{viewId}' and clicking them should update activeView state, triggering AppViewRouter to render the corresponding lazy-loaded component.
detailed_notes.observed_behavior: Clicking sidebar menu items (e.g., GUDANG group, then Status Stok submenu) did not consistently trigger view changes. Page remained on dashboard or returned to login screen. This suggests either: (1) event handlers not firing, (2) state updates not propagating, (3) lazy component loading failing, or (4) session/auth issues during navigation.
detailed_notes.environment_notes: Frontend served from static build (frontend/build) with no hot reload. Testing via public URL: https://nusantara-erp-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Browser automation with Playwright in headless mode.
recommendations_for_main_agent: Add console logging to navigation handlers (onNavSelect in App.js) to trace state changes
Verify Suspense fallback and lazy loading work correctly for all E-7 views
Check if authentication token is being maintained across navigation
Consider adding data-testid to view containers for easier test verification
Test navigation manually in browser dev tools to isolate if issue is automation-specific
Add URL query parameter support (?view=inventory-board) as mentioned in resolveDeepLinkTarget for easier testing
